title: Service carries the seeker across
summary: The fourth state is not reached by more roaming; the True Guru makes union known. Devotion and Guru-service become the crossing the restless seeker could not invent.
takeaway: Cross through devotion and service, not another search for novelty.
lifeApplication: When you want to escape into one more option, choose one concrete act of devotion or seva already in front of you. Let the known path carry you farther than restless searching.

source.shortMeaning: The True Guru reveals union with the Lord, and devotion with Guru-service carries the seeker across.
source.lifeApplication: When restlessness asks for novelty, make devotion concrete through the service already given to you.

evidence.coreClaim: The True Guru reveals union with the Lord, and devotion with Guru-service carries the seeker across.
evidence.turn: The shabad moves the seeker from circling states of mind into a crossing made by devotion and service.
